partition_rules.spatial: Walk parent_id toward RC:CITY:001; the first RC:DISTRICT:* ancestor owns the object. City-rooted/cross-city infrastructure remains in the city domain.
partition_rules.planning: Resolve target_ids through spatial ownership. A single child-domain target inherits that domain; city-level, multi-domain, or unresolved targets remain in the city domain.
partition_rules.raw_data: ReferenceCity source objects remain external. Domain ledgers store subject_ref plus RFC8785-JCS external_payload_digest commitments, never source geometry or full planning payloads.

required_properties: every source object assigned exactly once
city domain checkpoint commits all district checkpoints
district raw geometry absent from ledgers and cross-domain proofs
cross-district proof binds source entry, Merkle root, city commitment and validator delegation
